jobs.prompt:
Vertical 9:16, 8K cinematic photoreal 3D miniature diorama. Topic: “라켓을 길게 만들면 서브가 빨라질까”. Visual focus: 라켓 프레임 단면·진동·관성모멘트 디오라마. Keep the main subject in full color and secondary backgrounds low-saturation neutral, with technical-red leader lines and rapid MULTI-CUT / MULTI-SHOT flow. Use exactly one evidence layer—mechanism, specification or comparison—per cut, with at most two short English technical terms and two sourced numbers. Never invent precise metrics. No narration, voice-over, dialogue, music, sound effects or generated audio.

CUT-SPECIFIC DIRECTION — CUT 01. Visualize the meaning of the narration “서브 한 번. 라켓 길이 하나로 결과가 달라질 수 있습니다.” with the most direct camera angle and shot size. Allow only the evidence label “SUBJECT” and keep it readable for 0.8–1.5 seconds.

[REFERENCE LOCK] The supplied reference images are authoritative geometry, proportion and identity guides, not scenes to copy.
Use reference/basicrefer_court.png, basicrefer_tennisball.png, basicrefer_net.png and basicrefer_racket.png as input references.
Match court markings and proportions, the ball sphere/seam/felt, net mesh/top band/posts, and racket frame/grip/string plane to the references.
No warped, melted, duplicated or asymmetric tennis equipment and no frame-to-frame topology or scale drift.
Only when a narrative mascot or presenter is needed, use Tedori from tedori_character_sheet_final.png and tedori_original_reference.png. Otherwise show no character.
Whenever signage or a brand mark is needed, use only the Tennisnote logo or icon references. Never invent a third-party or fictional brand/logo.

referencePolicy.geometry: 테니스 코트·공·네트·라켓의 비율과 구조는 레퍼런스 형태를 잠그고 왜곡·융해·중복·비대칭 변형을 금지합니다.
